bio: Clay Wachholz is a longtime brass educator in the drum corps activity. He marched baritone with the Madison Scouts (1985-1989), where he was the 1988 DCI Individual Baritone Champion and a member of the DCI Brass Ensemble Champion line, and went on to teach the Madison Scouts brass (1991-1997). He later served as a late-season brass instructor for Phantom Regiment and was named brass caption head of Pacific Crest in 2015. Wachholz holds a BA from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and an MM from the University of Michigan, and has worked as a high school band director in Wisconsin.

Jay Hagy was a member of the brass staff for the Madison Scouts Drum and Bugle Corps from 2009 to 2016, and served as a brass consultant for Pacific Crest's 2019 season. He holds a Master's degree in Tuba Performance from the University of Alabama, where he studied under Demondrae Thurman and Mike Dunn, served as a Graduate Teaching Assistant with the Million Dollar Band, and directed the University of Alabama Euphonium and Tuba Ensemble. He was part of the Alabama Tuba Quartet, which won the International Tuba-Euphonium Conference Tuba Quartet competition in 2008. He has since worked as a middle and high school band director in Texas and Missouri.

Jennifer Hanford is an instructor with a comprehensive background in the marching arts as both teacher and performer. She served as a visual technician with DCI World Class semifinalist Genesis Drum and Bugle Corps in 2014 and 2015, specializing in technique and body choreography, and has been listed on the Crossmen Drum & Bugle Corps staff. As a performer, she marched euphonium and baritone with the World Champion Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps in 2010 and 2011. She serves as an Assistant Band Director at James Bowie High School in Austin, Texas, where she oversees visual and woodwind education for the marching ensemble. Jennifer earned her Bachelor's degree in Music from the University of Tulsa and an education certification from the University of Arkansas.

Jordan Lalama is a program coordinator, visual instructor, and choreographer for marching bands across the United States, originally from Carmel, Indiana. He began his career as a traveling clinician for Dynamic Marching before joining the staff of Broken Arrow High School's marching band in 2013. His drum corps résumé includes teaching positions with the Blue Stars, the Colts, and the Phantom Regiment.

Matt Gonzalez is an active marching arts educator based in the Los Angeles area of Southern California. He performed with award-winning percussion groups including The Blue Devils, RCC, Pulse Percussion, POW Percussion, and The Academy. He has taught percussion at world-renowned groups including the Blue Knights Drum & Bugle Corps and Broken City Percussion, as well as high schools such as Mission Viejo HS and Chino Hills HS.
